response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development with diverse technologies (C++, D, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, etc.) and a strong focus on quality assurance, testing, and modern development practices. However, his experience in geospatial data processing and routing/navigation systems is limited or not explicitly highlighted, and his primary expertise leans toward web/mobile applications and backend services rather than low-latency, high-throughput geospatial pipelines. His recent work in routing-relevant domains (e.g., GISCollective) is promising but not deeply aligned with the job's core requirements.
strengths: Strong background in C++ and modern software engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Experience with distributed systems and low-latency applications (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec)
Proven ability to design and build scalable platforms (e.g., GISCollective, open-source contributions)
concerns: Limited direct experience with geospatial/navigation data pipelines or routing systems
Primary focus has been on web/mobile applications rather than high-performance, low-latency routing data processing
Recent roles (e.g., AI-agent infrastructure, pricing platforms) do not align closely with routing/tiling responsibilities
